entries.title: Rotating Sun and Moving Object Casting Dynamic Ground Shadows
entries.description: A bright sun-sphere slowly orbits above a flat white plane while colored cubes glide, bounce, and rotate across it, each cube casting soft, elongated shadows that stretch, shrink, and skew realistically with a faint gray transparency.

entries.title: Solar Eclipse Shadow Sweep Over a Miniature City
entries.description: A glowing sun and a dark, slowly orbiting moon-sphere cast a moving eclipse shadow over a grid of simple buildings, where the sweeping dark circle dims colors, triggers building lights to glow on, and leaves a faint trailing contour of the shadow path.

entries.title: Rotating Lattice of Transparent Rods Creating Moiré Shadow Patterns
entries.description: A 3D lattice of thin, semi-transparent rods slowly rotates above a plane, casting intricate crisscrossing shadows that create moving moiré patterns, with a slider object that changes rod spacing and thus how the shadow patterns condense and dissolve.
